newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: GPA Group says Q2 net profit $8.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: GPA Group says Q2 net profit $8.4 mln.

text.p: GPA Group Plc said on Tuesday that it made a net profit of $8.4 million in the quarter ended September 30, 1996 compared with a net loss of $8 million in the same period of 1995.
Net profits for the six months to September 30 totalled $23.7 million comapred with a net loss of $16 million a year earlier, GPA said in a statement.

Revenue for the six-month period was $173 million, down from $482 million, while net interest expense amounted to $12 million compared with $173 million last year. Cashflow fell to $22 million from $268 million, GPA said.

"Compared with the same period in 1995, the drop in revenue, net interest expense and cashflow, and the reduction in total assets to $1,733 million resulted from the sale of 229 aircraft to Airplanes Group in March 1996," the company said in a statement.
Commenting on the results, GPA chief executive Neil Blaney said the group's earnings reflected the continuing improvement in market conditions during the period.
Following GPA's refinancing in March, the company is restructuring its balance sheet with the elimination of the deficit in the company's distributable reserves by a capital reduction, he said.

Special resolutions to this effect were passed by the company at an extraordinary meeting on October 2 and GPA said it would shortly be petitioning the High Court to seek confirmation of this arrangement.
